# BeepBeep

> A desktop download manager (NSH, Rust + TSX) with segmented, resumable HTTP(S) downloads and video downloads from X, Threads and Instagram post links. AI assistants can drive it through an MCP server (`beep mcp`) or the CLI's `--json` output.

## Use it from an AI assistant

- MCP server: run `beep mcp [-o DOWNLOAD_DIR] [--state STATE_DIR]` over stdio. Tools: add_download(urls[], quality?), list_downloads(filter?, limit?), get_download(id), pause_download(id), resume_download(id), remove_download(id, delete_file?) [destructive], resolve_link(url), get_status().
- CLI: `beep get <url>... --json`, `beep list --json`, `beep resolve <url> --json`, `beep probe <url> --json`.
- Accepted links: direct http(s) files; x.com / twitter.com `/status/<id>`; threads.net / threads.com `/@user/post/<code>`; instagram.com `/p/`, `/reel/`, `/reels/`, `/tv/`.
- Quality: best, 1080, 720, 480, audio (the highest rendition at or under the cap).
- Public posts need no account. Posts that need a login use yt-dlp with the user's chosen browser cookies; BeepBeep never bypasses DRM, paywalls or private accounts.
